reviews.title: I have an ASUS motherboard and the ATX 12V (4 + 4 PIN) is not there.
reviews.comment: I have an ASUS motherboard and the ATX 12V (4 + 4 PIN) is not there, so the computer would not start up.  I had to return it. You need to be very carefull about this supply. Not for ASUS!!! It didn't work.
reviews.author: Vassilis Kitsos

reviews.title: It’s all about the power
reviews.comment:
This is a review for 1000W Power Supply Full Voltage 100-240V Active PFC Gaming PSU Computer Power Supplies Non-Modular 80 Plus Gold Power Supply for Desktop PC Server.
This power supply is great for a powerfully built PC. I have rarely needed more than 800W in most builds I do but it’s great to have the extra power in case you want some peripherals that just need that power.
The power supply seems to be well made and built to take the constant demand. It is also much quieter than other power supplies I have used in the past. The output is very consistent and reliable. I will definitely be using these brand power supplies in the future.
reviews.author: devildawg
